title: [Epic] Product areas and grading rollout: rule text, area labels, backfill, regrade
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbabAdcWyApSTGBYJNY

Filing gate: the maintainer's word in the objectstack priorities discussion, 2026-11-18, verbatim: 「立一张专题卡，开始执行」 (14:43Z), after 「同意，然后立一张专题卡处理相关任务？」 (14:33Z) and 「同意」 to the four review changes (14:42Z). Executor: objectstack seat 1, named by the maintainer. It runs in parallel with #35159. The children are rule PRs and label work, not product development, so they take no #35159 dev slot.

## What this is

The objectstack backlog moves to six standing product areas, with one `area:*` label per card, a GitHub issue type per card (Bug / Feature / Task), and a lookup-table grading rule. This epic carries the rule text, the labels, the backfill of the open cards, the regrade, and the clean-up.

## Final structure (as agreed)

- Six product areas, one label each:
  - `area:ai` (AI)
  - `area:build` (building apps)
  - `area:data` (data and permissions, including sign-in, organizations, audit, search and query performance)
  - `area:workflow` (flows and integration)
  - `area:ux` (experience, including i18n, mobile, the shell and navigation, and page load)
  - `area:package` (packages and install)
- Also `area:fleet` (the fleet's own tooling) and `area:cloud` (hosted dependencies, paused).
- Security is its own area and lives only in the private security channel. Security cards carry no `area:*` (maintainer, 14:41Z: 「就是私密的安全卡」). Performance is not a separate area (14:38Z: 「感觉性能优化不需要单独专题」).
- The six areas are standing labels. A sub-epic is a temporary `pm:epic`, and only the maintainer opens one.
- Grading:
  - Bug: severity × how often it is hit, looked up in the table, with a new cell: "broken × used daily by builders = p1".
  - Security: who can trigger it × who gains what.
  - A Feature never enters p1. A Task defaults to p3.
  - A card blocking another repo's p1 takes that p1's grade.
  - p1 goes ahead of every area. A paused area no longer demotes its cards.
  - In-flight cards are not regraded.

## Authorization

This time seat 1 grades in triage's place and backfills existing cards. The maintainer authorized it as a one-off exception, by 「立一张专题卡，开始执行」 on the plan that named it. It overrides two rules for this epic only:
- `references/lanes/objectstack.md`: "first touch and grading stay with triage".
- `SKILL.md`:128: "⛔ no backfill of existing cards".

## Children, in order (rules merge first, then cards move)

1. Rule PR: the north-star document. The maintainer merges it.
2. Rule PR: pm-dispatch, `ensure-pm-labels.sh`, the checklist `axis` fields and the scripts that read the old type labels. The maintainer merges it.
3. Labels: create the new area labels, rewrite the descriptions of the three kept ones, and trial the issue types on one card.
4. Backfill: area and issue type on the open cards, in groups of ten.
5. Regrade: per the regrade list, with one line per card.
6. `pm:epic` clean-up.
7. Map each core feature to a platform-checklist item, and add the missing ones.
8. Closing sweep of cards opened after the 14:30Z snapshot that have no area.

## Still open (to be settled in the discussion thread, then added here)

- Who sets area, type and grade on a new card. The proposal is that the filer sets them and triage's first touch reviews them.
- Whether cloud adopts the same rules.

`area:fleet` is added to this card once that label exists (child 3). The card closes when every child is done.
